item_short_desc: Whether you're exploring the great outdoors or enjoying a camping trip, Rothco's 2 Quart Striped Desert Canteen is a reliable companion for staying hydrated. It features a sturdy plastic/polyethylene inner body with a tinplate outer body for durability. The soft terylene and acrylic fabric cover adds comfort and style while ensuring a secure grip. This BPA-free canteen offers a safe drinking experience, and the screw-on cap is conveniently attached to prevent loss.
